extracted.name: Worlds most amazing Short Ribs - just try it - it will become a family favourite treat:P
extracted.description: ok This is super simple and luxary dish I think in England we think "short Ribs" is an american thing but really this is AMAZING:P put in the oven and then serve - ENJOY:P
ingredient_lines: 1 cup dry red wine (such as Cote du Rhone or Pinot Noir)
instruction_lines: Heat half the oil in a cassaole pan (with lid) and then add the onions on medium for 5-6 mins until softens add the carrots and garlic. Then remove to dish and add the rest of oil. Pre hear oven to 175C

Coat the Beef in the flour on all sided then add to pot and sear on all sides until browned. Remove and put ontop of veg. Then pour in the Wine and broth and tomat0 paste. Add back the Beef and then the Veg around it. Add the Herbs and bring to simmer then add the lid and put into Oven. Cook for 2:30 - 3 Hrs until the meat is falling from Bone.
Remove beef and veg to serving dish. remove the HARD herbs and disgard. Then put back into over to reduce and thicken then sauce for 10-15 mins. Then Serve with sauce on side. ENJOY:P
